Admin Assistant Job at Center for Humanitarian Impact and Development (C-HID)




        
    

        
        The Center for Humanitarian Impact and Development (C-HID) is a humanitarian and development organization committed to empowering communities for sustainable growth and strengthening the resilience and well-being of vulnerable and underserved populations. C-HID works across key areas including Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), Food Security and Livelihoods, Health and Nutrition, Protection, Education, Climate Action, Renewable Energy, environmental restoration and other community development interventions.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Admin Assistant

Job Location: Gujba, Yobe

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Provide day-to-day administrative support to the project and field team.
	Maintain accurate filing systems, records, correspondence and administrative documents.
	Support meetings, workshops, trainings and programme activities.
	Assist with logistics, office management and administrative processes.
	Support documentation of attendance, movement, supplies and other administrative records.


Requirements


	Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree, HND or equivalent in Business Administration, Management, Public Administration or a related field, with relevant administrative experience.
	Relevant qualifications and experience for the position applied for.
	Good communication, interpersonal, documentation and teamwork skills.
	Commitment to humanitarian principles, accountability, inclusion and respect for affected communities.
	Ability and willingness to work in challenging field environments.
	Integrity, professionalism and compliance with C-HID policies, Code of Conduct, safeguarding, PSEA, anti-fraud and anti-corruption requirements.
	Knowledge of Gujba and/or Buni Yadi is an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV and cover letter indicating the position and preferred duty station, together with relevant certificates where applicable and two professional referees to: [email protected] cc: [email protected] using "Application – [Position] – [Gujba/Buni Yadi]" as the subject of the email.

Note


	Applications should be submitted as one PDF document.
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	C-HID reserves the right to conduct reference checks and verify submitted qualifications.
	C-HID does not charge any fee at any stage of recruitment.
	Candidates should not offer money, gifts or inducements in connection with recruitment.
	Fraudulent or unethical attempts to influence recruitment may result in disqualification.
	C-HID maintains zero tolerance for sexual exploitation and abuse, fraud, corruption, harassment and abuse of power.
	C-HID is an equal opportunity organization and encourages qualified candidates to apply.

Business Development Executive Job at Dorisfit




        
    

        
        Dorisfit is into wellness and healthy living. We render home service for various kinds of body massage therapy and personal training to keep fit and nice body shape. We also put you on a healthy diet a through our research nutrition you will live healthy and stay longer. Also, skin problems and issues we have good skincare products to help solve that. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Executive

Job Location: Alimosho, Ikeja, Agege, Surulere - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
	Arrange business meetings with prospective clients
	Promote the company’s products/services addressing or predicting clients’ objectives
	Prepare sales contract ensuring adherence to law-established rules and guidelines
	Keep records of sales, revenue, invoices
	Provide trustworthy feedback and after-sales support
	Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an OND, HND or B.Sc. with 2-7 years of experience.


Salary
N200,000 - N350,000 / Month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
